title: Transfer a SIP call with REFER
summary: Hand a SIP call to another endpoint with a REFER, sending the destination URI and, when the far end asks for them, credentials.
scenario: A PBX wants the desk phone itself to complete the transfer rather than bridging a second leg

folds: round 7 gap: live-call control over REST
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/calling/calls description, command table: calling.refer "Transfer a SIP call via SIP REFER"

tools/openapi/rest.json Calling.CallRequest variant calling.refer: params required device; Calling.ReferDevice requires type and params; CallingReferDeviceType enum is exactly [sip]; Calling.ReferSipParams requires to (must start with sip:), with optional from (must start with sip: when provided), username and password; status_url receives refer lifecycle webhooks
npm @signalwire/sdk 2.0.5 client.calling.refer sends the same body
